menu.title: What would you like to add?
menu.createBody: Put one together from your wardrobe
menu.importBody: Turn outfit photos from your gallery into looks · up to {{max}} photos
menu.importBodyNoMax: Turn outfit photos from your gallery into looks

intro.heading: Let's turn your photos into looks
intro.step1: Pick up to {{max}} outfit photos from your gallery.
intro.step1NoMax: Pick outfit photos from your gallery.
intro.step2: We find the pieces in each photo and match them with your wardrobe. A piece in several photos is added once.
intro.step3: Each photo becomes a look. You check them and approve with one tap.
intro.quotaBody: Each photo uses 1; a photo with no pieces found uses none.
intro.privacy: Photos are made smaller on your phone and their location is removed. Originals are deleted within 7 days; only the looks and pieces you approve stay.
intro.pickLimitFree: You can choose up to {{count}} photos (your recognitions left)
intro.pickLimit: You can choose up to {{count}} photos

progress.explain: We are finding the pieces and comparing them with your wardrobe. You can leave this screen; we will let you know in Notifications.
progress.retryA11y: Photo {{n}} could not be uploaded, try again
progress.reviewHint: Opens when every photo is processed · photos that failed to upload are not waited for

review.title: Review
review.summary: {{newCount}} new pieces · {{matchedCount}} already in your wardrobe. Only the new pieces you add get their background cleaned.
review.noPieces: We found no pieces in this photo. It will not become a look, and no recognition was used.
review.approveHint: Unticked pieces and switched-off looks are not added
review.discardBody: The photos and the pieces found are deleted. Unused recognitions come back.
review.commitFailed: Could not approve. Your list is still here; you can try again.

done.body: {{count}} new pieces were added to your wardrobe. Their backgrounds are being cleaned; in a few minutes they will look like product photos.
done.bodyNoItems: Your pieces were already in your wardrobe; no new pieces were added.
done.coverNote: Your own photo is the cover of each look. Open any look to edit it.

states.noneTitle: We found no pieces in these photos
states.noneBody: Choose photos where your clothes are clearly visible, full-length or in front of a mirror. This try used no recognitions.
states.quotaTitle: Your free recognitions are used up
states.quotaBody: Importing uses 1 recognition per photo. Membership makes recognition unlimited; the photo limit stays {{max}}.
states.quotaFooter: Imports you started while you had recognitions are not affected; you can still review and approve them.
states.pausedBody: No connection. The other {{left}} photos are waiting on your phone and continue when you are back online. The {{done}} uploaded photos are still being processed.
states.overLimit: You can choose up to {{max}} photos; the first {{max}} were taken.
states.quotaSkipped: You have {{left}} recognitions: the first {{left}} photos will be processed; become a member for the other {{skipped}}.
states.startFailed: The import could not start. Your photos are still on your phone; you can try again.
states.photoFailed: The photos could not be prepared. Try again.
states.loadFailed: The import could not be opened.

notif.title: Your outfits are ready
notif.body: Looks were drafted from the photos you imported. Review and approve them.
